interface.tenant_id: optional query string, 1..512 characters; when supplied must be allowed by the authenticated server-side service grant
authority: existing sealed engine bearer service token
verified x-zaibatsu-attester service principal with an existing server-side EngineServiceGrant
global non-secret readiness only when tenant is omitted; no tenant data or execution authority is exposed

response.available: canonical ProviderRegistry.available boolean, including mandatory architecture acknowledgement and declared fallback readiness
response.providers: canonical ProviderRegistry.statuses non-secret projections, including local artifact receipt and architecture acknowledgement

interface.bounds: configured canonical registry inventory only; no caller-supplied provider IDs, credentials, transport URLs, artifact paths, policy changes or model allocations

failure.401: missing or invalid service token or service-principal header
failure.403: ungranted service principal, missing engine:read scope or denied explicit tenant
failure.503: engine provider registry unavailable or active provider undeclared
failure.degraded: configured but unavailable or unacknowledged provider returns canonical available=false without leaking internal errors

scope_limitations: read-only projection of existing provider ownership and existing service authority
no provider transport, model inference, new service scope or tenant-data authority
candidate interface addition does not alter signed closure evidence or assert model/masterplan promotion
